        Roof leaks

        We locate and repair leak sources before water damages ceilings, insulation, walls or interior finishes.

        Drainage, ice and snow

        Blocked eavestroughs, poor drainage, ice buildup and heavy snow can stress the roof. Eavestrough cleaning and snow removal help reduce that risk.

        Storm and wind damage

        Toronto storms can lift shingles, damage flashing and create weak points. Timely repair helps stop further damage.
